snippet.description:
What does “Critically Analyse” actually mean in UPSC Mains answer writing?

A common mistake among UPSC aspirants is to interpret “critically analyse” as “criticise.” But critically analysing a topic means evaluating and analysing it, not simply pointing out its shortcomings or criticising it.

In this short, understand the correct meaning of “Critically Analyse” and avoid one of the most common mistakes while interpreting UPSC directive words.

A clear understanding of directive words is essential for understanding the demand of the question and writing better UPSC Mains answers.
